unfindable.note: StormAudio Calibration Kit is sold as a flight-case accessory (calibrated UMIK-1 microphone + stands + USB/CAT5 cables). No dedicated product page, thumbnail image, or PDF spec sheet is published on stormaudio.com; it only appears in dealer price lists and on the Room Calibration page (https://www.stormaudio.com/room-calibration/).

StormAudio Microphone Mini-Kit (calibrated microphone + Pod + USB/CAT5 cable & extender) does not have its own product page, image asset, or spec sheet on stormaudio.com; it only appears in dealer listings (e.g. nintronics.co.uk) and the Room Calibration overview page.
